capabilities: Build timelines from dated notes and historical spans
Explore notes on an interactive timeline view
Save timeline output as Markdown or JSON
Create and reuse named timeline views
extras: Core timeline use is local, but purchases require a Constance account and credits bought through Paddle (USD). The plugin sends error reports to Datadog and basic usage events to an analytics service, and failed-operation reports may include file paths or content. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0+. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view dated notes arranged chronologically on an interactive timeline.
summary: Timeline tool that plots dated notes and historical spans on an interactive, local-only timeline and saves the output as Markdown or JSON.
